name: strata
description: STRATA Physics-Informed Spatio-Temporal Deep Learning Framework

scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix web run dev" ".venv/bin/python -m uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir python"
scripts.check: npm --prefix web run check && .venv/bin/python -m pytest python/tests -q && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check python && .venv/bin/python -m mypy --config-file python/pyproject.toml python/strata python/api && node scripts/check-no-comments.mjs
